disgusting things baseball girls do but never admit... 1. we wear the same socks way longer than we should. practice. game. another practice. if they’re not completely soaked yet, somehow they’re still “good.” 2. we eat with hands that definitely touched dirt five minutes earlier. glove. bat. dugout bench. dirty ball. then suddenly you’re halfway through a granola bar like none of that happened. 3. some of us absolutely change in the car after games. sweaty uniform off. shorts on. dirty cleats thrown somewhere in the back. and yes, the whole car smells like a locker room afterward. 4. our bags are disgusting. old tape. half-empty drinks. dirty socks. random snacks crushed at the bottom. sometimes you open it and immediately regret it. 5. we sit around in sweaty uniforms way too long. after a game, nobody wants to change right away. so you’re just sitting there in dirt, sweat and grass stains like it’s completely normal. people love imagining baseball girls somehow stay cute and clean the whole time. bro. we slide through dirt for fun. some of us are just better at hiding how gross it actually gets.

Walking on gravel might look uncomfortable, but it’s actually one of my favorite ways to wake up the muscles in my feet. 🪨🌿 Our feet weren’t designed to spend every day on perfectly flat surfaces. Walking on uneven ground, like the gravel around the farm, challenges the small muscles in your feet and ankles, improves balance, and can help build stronger, more resilient feet. 👣✨ It definitely takes some getting used to, but for me it’s just another part of farm life. 🤎 Have you ever tried walking on gravel?  #FootHealth #NaturalMovement #CountryLiving #HealthyFeet #strongmen
